title: Provision of Distribution panel, air conditioners, LED lights and Garden lights at Chennai Lighthouse
summary: E-tender (two-cover) for providing a distribution panel, air conditioners, LED lights and garden lights at Chennai Lighthouse, Tamil Nadu (Chennai Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Chennai Lighthouse
sites.work: Provision of distribution panel, air conditioners, LED lights and garden lights

scope.item: Provision of Distribution panel, air conditioners, LED lights and Garden lights

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalised bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; valid 90 days from technical bid opening; exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate.

eligibility: OEMs or authorised agents, or appropriate class contractors registered with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies, having experience in electrification, rewiring of buildings and UG cable works (Hindi version also mentions street light pole erection)
notes: Scanned Section 1 NIT only (printed pages 3-4); no BOQ or equipment specification. Download, bid and EMD submission 10.07.2025 10:00 to 24.07.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 25.07.2025 15:30. Page 4 shows faint bleed-through of the previous page.
